## d5df53fde4de

**Status: Reproduced documentation defect.** The selected `SUMMARY.md` says to paint every cell in each nonzero component’s bounding box, while the executed authority paints only the bounding-box border. I generated a default validator-passing easy example (`seed=910001`, `sample_index=1`) containing a 3×3 component; its center cell remains color 8 under authority rule hash `bc1f4cf5196a` but becomes 9 under the summary-described fill-entire-box rival.

Evidence: `checks/audit/d5df53fde4de/input.json`, `checks/audit/d5df53fde4de/racket.json`, and `checks/audit/d5df53fde4de/counterexample.json`. The counterexample records generator SHA-256 `e34e1126068acdae5e9299ddefbea709eefb6d37258241b030b2a8b90e7b3cf8`, an empty `self_check` finding list, exact outputs, hashes, and the supported `arcpuzzles apply` command. A separate 600-scene sample found the generator frequently emits boxes with interiors, so generated lessons can refute the prose rival; the concrete defect is the selected documentation/authority mismatch. Audit target left unchanged.
